title: Dish Soap vs Dishwasher Detergent: A This Old House Demonstration on Why Soap Matters in Dishwashers

locations.name: kitchen (probable)
locations.basis: Transcript references the kitchen context (foam covering the kitchen) but affords no explicit filming location; treating as probable scene context rather than confirmed shooting location.

summary: This video contrasts dish liquid (hand-washing soap) with dishwasher detergent gel, emphasizing that they are not interchangeable. Through narration and a live in-dishwasher test, the hosts show how using ordinary dish soap in a dishwasher creates heavy suds that overflow the basin, leak from the door, and can contaminate the floor. The demonstration uses interior camera views to observe the wash cycle, revealing foam choking the wash arm and a mounting mess that requires cleanup with a wet vac and mop. The host then confesses that the mess was caused by putting the wrong product in, underscoring the practical lesson: always use the proper dishwasher detergent and keep dish soap for handwashing. The segment ends with cleanup tips and a reminder that soaps differ in concentration and formulation.

sections.title: Dish Soap vs Dishwasher Detergent: What Goes in the Dishwasher
sections.description: The host introduces the topic by distinguishing dish liquid, used for hand washing and known to be highly concentrated, from dishwasher detergent gel, formulated specifically for dishwashers and less concentrated. The explanation stresses that not all soaps are created equal and that using the wrong product can lead to poor or dangerous results, especially if a full load is treated as if it were compatible with dishwasher detergent.

sections.title: Live Test: What Happens When Dish Soap Is Used in a Dishwasher
sections.description: A live test using the dishwasher demonstrates the consequences of using dish soap instead of dishwasher detergent. The narrator notes that the soap door opens during the cycle, bubbles erupt, and foam clogs the wash arm. Cameras inside the appliance capture the foam and its spread, with foam leaking out and dripping onto the floor. The segment highlights how the detergent’s concentration and formulation affect performance during the pre-rinse and wash phases, resulting in a kitchen-wide foam overflow.

sections.title: Cleanup and Confession
sections.description: The hosts explain cleanup steps after the overflow: using a wet vac and mopping to remove suds and residue, since the concentrated detergent can linger at the bottom. A humorous confession reveals that the mess was caused by putting the wrong product in, underscoring the practical takeaway: always use the correct dishwasher detergent and avoid substitutions.
